question.wording: Is this item a personal, living or family expense rather than a business expense?

options.label: No — an ordinary and necessary business expense

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item a personal, living or family expense rather than a business expense?

citation.wording: Do not include the cost of business equipment or furniture; replacements or permanent improvements to property; or personal, living, and family expenses.
